title: Benefits of aflibercept treatment for age-related macular degeneration patients with good best-corrected visual acuity at baseline
condition: Treatment-naive exudative AMD with good baseline BCVA (better than 0.6 Landolt C, better than 74 ETDRS letters); 29 eyes of 29 patients, Keio University Hospital, 2013-2015; prospective single-arm interventional study (UMIN000012221); subtypes typical AMD 11, PCV 17, RAP 1

groups.description: Whole cohort: monthly injections for 3 months, then every 2 months (2Q8) to month 12, IVA monotherapy per protocol; monthly follow-up

exclusions.what: Table 3 CCT, macular volume and choroidal area rows
exclusions.reason: Choroidal thickness, macular volume and choroidal areas are out of scope

exclusions.what: Table 3 BCVA, contrast VA, FVA, VMR, GLD, IOP and VFQ-25 rows; p-value columns
exclusions.reason: Not thickness outcomes; p-values are not extracted
Correlation coefficients and p-values are not extracted
Figure only; no tabulated cells to cite

notes: Measure: CRT on Heidelberg Spectralis without a subfield definition in Methods (the ETDRS 6-mm area is defined only for macular volume): central_unspecified.
Regimen fixed_interval: monthly for 3 months then every 2 months (2Q8), no additional treatments per protocol.

The Methods describe included patients as having attended for at least 12 months with IVA as the only treatment; the Results attribute this to the monotherapy protocol and the one dropout is retained at baseline, so the cohort is treated as all enrolled eyes rather than an outcome-selected set.
Role control: approved agent, single-arm cohort.

series.notes: Mean +/- SD (Table 3 footnote); months after the initial injection; one patient dropped out after the 11-month visit and his month-12 data were not included (observed cases at month 12, ordinary attrition)
